ci: update github actions to their latest versions (#38)

Updates every GitHub Action this repo uses to its latest release.

- `actions/setup-node` v6 → v7 (release.yml)

**Breaking changes checked:**
- setup-node v6+ only auto-caches npm, and v7 no longer exports a
placeholder `NODE_AUTH_TOKEN`.

All of these run on GitHub-hosted runners, which support the Node 24
action runtime. `actionlint` reports nothing new.
